title: Rideable Shooter
content:
Rideable Shooter

Shooter component for rideable or mountable entities, enabling mounted weapon systems.

Component Weapon

Schema

JSON
"rideableShooter": {
  "projectileEntity": "...",
  "fireRate": 0.0,
  "spread": 0.0
}

Description

The RideableShooter component enables entities to function as mounted weapon platforms. When a mob entity rides or mounts another entity equipped with this component, they can control its shooting capabilities. This is commonly used for turrets, vehicles, and rideable creatures with ranged attacks.

Fields

NameTypeDescription
projectileEntitystringThe entity ID of the projectile to fire.
fireRatefloatTime in seconds between shots.
spreadfloatAngular spread of fired projectiles in degrees.

Example

JSON
{
  "components": {
    "rideableShooter": {
      "projectileEntity": "turret_bullet",
      "fireRate": 0.15,
      "spread": 5.0
    }
  }
}
